messages:
Mara Chen: Quick UX review of org settings > roles. Problem: rows become very tall when people have many roles. Proposal: compact mode with wrapped role chips and a +N overflow. Make Invite CTA sticky.

Joel Patel: +1. Prefer a popover for +N rather than inline expand to avoid layout shift. Popover should trap focus.

Priya Singh: Accessibility notes: +N must be keyboard-focusable, announce as "X more roles", and popover needs aria-expanded/aria-controls. Ensure focus returns to the chip list after closing.

Aaron Li: Implementation note: we can use a visually-hidden list for screen readers if we render overflow items in the popover. Will add analytics event overflow_open.

Mara Chen: SSO toggle copy is ambiguous. Suggest keeping short label "Enforce SSO for members" + info icon with tooltip: "Guests not affected unless guest SSO enabled." Tooltip must be keyboard accessible.

Joel Patel: Agreed. Also show a small badge when guest SSO is on.

Priya Singh: Tooltip must meet contrast and size (14px, 4.5:1). Add to a11y checklist.

Mara Chen: CSV invite flow: admins get success toast but no quick way to inspect failed rows. Add action in toast: "View import errors" -> modal listing row, email, reason, and "Download failures CSV" CTA.

Aaron Li: Backend will return import_job_id and errors endpoint /orgs/:org/imports/:id/errors. We'll wire a route and telemetry invite_csv_errors + invite_retry_rate.

Joel Patel: Audit log UX: preserve filters in URL query params so back/forward keeps state. Also return focus to previously focused row after closing details.

Mara Chen: Decision: ship compact roles behind feature flag, dogfood internally, collect metrics (roles_compact_toggle, invite_csv_errors, invite_success_rate). Aaron to create flag.

Priya Singh: Copy tweak: change primary CTA to "Invite people" when multiple emails allowed. Ensure aria-live announces "N invitations sent" for screen readers.

DesignBot: Prototyping tip: 36px chip height, 6px gap, test with VoiceOver and 14px baseline.

Mara Chen: I'll update the spec with interactions, tooltip copy, import-errors UX, URL-as-state requirement. Leaving thread open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
